Message:
r8152: store the information of the pipes

Store the information of the pipes to avoid calling usb_rcvctrlpipe(),
usb_sndctrlpipe(), usb_rcvbulkpipe(), usb_sndbulkpipe(), and
usb_rcvintpipe() frequently.
